$comment: English texts of data/unlocks.json, by the unlock's id (src/engine/overlay.js): the names of the parts of the game as the locked screen names them, and the System's messages when they open. The condition follows "{name} unlocks" (src/client/screens/locked.js).

stats.name: Free points and the Stats screen
stats.message: Stats screen unlocked. You can spend free points in the Character tab.

quick-hunts.name: Quick Hunt
quick-hunts.message: Quick Hunt unlocked: three quick explorations a day, with the report at once. Find it in Combat, below “Set out”.

community.name: Community
community.message: Community unlocked. In the Community tab you can talk with other players in the chat.

portals.name: Portals
portals.message: System Portals unlocked: fights for the next stages as often as you like, and sweeps of the stages you have cleared, with the loot at once, even during an exploration. Each portal brings you something else: gold, camp resources, materials or parts. Find them in Combat, under Portals.

skills.name: Skills
skills.message: Skills unlocked. Choose one of three in the Character tab, under Skills.

evolution.name: Evolution
evolution.message: Evolution unlocked. Once both paths are ready, you will choose your class's evolution in the Character tab, under Evolution.

professions.name: Professions
professions.message: Professions unlocked. Look into the Professions tab.

crafting.name: Crafting
crafting.message: Crafting unlocked. The System Workshop waits in the Professions tab.

mining.name: Mining
mining.message: Mining unlocked. The System Mine waits in the Professions tab.

jewelcrafting.name: Jewelcrafting
jewelcrafting.message: Jewelcrafting unlocked. The System Gem Workshop waits in the Professions tab.

settlement.name: Settlement
settlement.message: Settlement unlocked. The residents wait in the Settlement tab.

party.name: Party
party.message: Party unlocked. Form one or accept an invitation in the Community tab, in the Party section, and set out on explorations together.

guild.name: Guild
guild.message: Creating a Guild unlocked. Create one in the Community tab, in the Guild section.

towers.name: Towers
towers.message: System Towers unlocked. Enter them in the Combat tab, in the Towers section: a dozen or so fights a day, between explorations and even while working at a profession.

core.name: Core
core.condition: after defeating the first dungeon boss
